Welcome

The approved mouse artwork greets the user on the first page. Other pages use static illustrations.

Full Disk Access

The real settings button opens the macOS Full Disk Access page. The app checks protected folder access before continuing.

Access required

A separately signed test app without a permission grant cannot continue. No scan index was created.

First scan

The final page explains CPU, disk activity, retained index storage, temporary scan storage, and the local-data policy.

Relaunch and range selection

After completion is saved in SQLite, relaunch opens the real indexed fixture. Shift+Down selects three folders; their context menu supports copying and revealing all selected items.
